methodologyZh: 研发项目按工程能力节点追踪，不把试验次数直接加入正式载荷发射总量。一次飞行若完成入轨任务，仍可同时出现在轨道发射统计中。
methodologyEn: Development programs are tracked by engineering milestones, not added as a second launch total. A test flight that reaches orbit may still appear in the orbital launch series.

programs.name: Starship / Super Heavy
programs.statusZh: 尚未开始常态载荷入轨；Flight 12 后处于事故调查与后续试验阶段。
programs.statusEn: Routine payload delivery has not begun; the program is in post-Flight 12 investigation and further testing.
programs.nextZh: 首次轨道载荷交付；SpaceX 当前目标为 2026 年下半年。
programs.nextEn: First orbital payload delivery; SpaceX currently targets the second half of 2026.

milestones.titleZh: 首次塔架捕获 Super Heavy
milestones.titleEn: First tower catch of Super Heavy

milestones.titleZh: Flight 11 完成主要试验目标
milestones.titleEn: Flight 11 met its major test objectives

milestones.titleZh: Flight 12 发射；一级返程异常

programs.name: 朱雀三号 / Zhuque-3
programs.statusZh: 遥二将鸿鹄03星送入预定轨道，一级依靠着陆支腿在陆地场坪完成软着陆；项目已从回收技术验证进入工程化复用验证。
programs.statusEn: Y2 delivered Honghu 03 to orbit and its first stage completed a landing-leg touchdown on a land pad; the program has moved from recovery demonstration into engineering reuse validation.
programs.nextZh: 完成回收箭体检查、维护与首次复飞，再验证高频商业服务。
programs.nextEn: Inspect and refurbish the recovered stage, then demonstrate its first reflight before high-cadence commercial service.

milestones.titleZh: VTVL-1 完成 10 公里级垂直起降
milestones.titleEn: VTVL-1 completed a 10 km vertical takeoff and landing

milestones.titleZh: 遥一二级入轨；一级回收失败
milestones.titleEn: Y1 reached orbit; first-stage recovery failed

milestones.titleZh: 遥二入轨并完成一级陆地软着陆
milestones.titleEn: Y2 reached orbit and landed its first stage on land

programs.name: 长征十号系列 / Long March 10 family
programs.provider: 中国航天科技集团 / CASC
programs.statusZh: 系列已完成系留点火、低空飞行，并由长征十号乙完成入轨与一级海上回收。
programs.statusEn: The family has completed captive firing and low-altitude flight, while Long March 10B demonstrated orbit insertion and at-sea first-stage recovery.
programs.nextZh: 把验证结果转化为稳定的载荷和载人运输任务。
programs.nextEn: Convert the demonstrations into sustained cargo and crew transportation missions.

milestones.titleZh: 七机并联系留点火成功
低空演示验证并完成海上打捞
长征十号乙入轨并完成一级海上网系回收
milestones.titleEn: Long March 10B reached orbit and recovered its first stage at sea
